create_UNet3DModel: create a 3D UNet model with configurable down/up blocks, timestep embedding, and residual connections
build_ResnetBlock3D: build a 3D residual block with group normalization, timestep embedding, and skip connections
build_DownBlock3D: build a 3D downsampling block with stacked resnet blocks and optional convolutional downsampling
build_UpBlock3D: build a 3D upsampling block with stacked resnet blocks, skip connections, and optional convolutional upsampling
run_UNet3DModel_forward: run the 3D UNet forward pass with noisy input tensor and timestep to produce denoised output
